SELECT a.account_id, c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A11,
       (SELECT MAX(d3.A11) FROM client c3 JOIN district d3 ON c3.district_id = d3.district_id WHERE c3.gender = 'F') 
       - (SELECT MIN(d2.A11) FROM client c2 JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE c2.gender = 'F') AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11) FROM client c2 JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1
